metadata.description: Creates the Azure-side trust for Grafana's secretless Azure Monitor connection: a managed identity, a federated credential trusting Grafana's OIDC issuer, and a Monitoring Reader role assignment scoped to this resource group. No client secret is created. Deploys entirely with your own Azure Portal session — Grafana never sees this deployment or holds any access to run it. Prototype limitation: Monitoring Reader is scoped to this resource group, not the whole subscription (cross-scope role assignments from a resource-group-scoped template need a nested subscription-level deployment, not yet built here) — widen the role assignment's scope by hand afterward if you need Grafana to see resources in other resource groups too.
Name for the managed identity Grafana will authenticate as.
Grafana's OIDC issuer URL. Do not change this — it must match exactly what Grafana's token service signs with.
The fixed identifier for your Grafana connection. Do not change this — Grafana derives it server-side and a mismatch here means auth will fail with AADSTS700213.
Fixed audience Azure AD expects for workload identity federation. Do not change.

instructions.value: Copy clientId, tenantId, and subscriptionId above into Grafana's Azure Monitor (secretless) datasource, or paste them where the Connect flow asked for them.
